meta.about: A target naming SEVERAL positions of one role styles all of them. Asserted on the receipt, because a style changes no wording and the call is identical either way.
meta.recorded-outcome: asked to make the takeaways yellow and bold, Gemma emitted style_node({"target": "takeaway 1, takeaway 2, takeaway 3, takeaway 4, takeaway 5, takeaway 6", ...}). `byOrdinal` read the first number in the phrase and nothing else, so ONE takeaway went yellow and the receipt reported success. Acting on a sixth of what was named, and saying it worked.
meta.guards: the receipt line. Revert `byOrdinal` to `words.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\b/)` and the call is byte-identical — only the receipt changes, to "color: yellow; font-weight: bold on slide 6, takeaway 1 — ...". A fixture asserting on `calls` alone could not fail here, which is why `expect.receipt` exists.
